authorised_by: user chose IFEO after the rule review

what_was_done.registry: HKCU\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\Grim Dawn.exe, value Debugger -> the wrapper
what_was_done.intent: have the system run the watcher at process creation so the guard is armed before any engine code

outcome.game_processes: one client started and ran normally
outcome.interpretation: The HKCU entry did not take effect for a Steam-initiated launch: the wrapper was never invoked, so no watch was armed.

why_it_matters: The remaining way to arm before creation is an HKLM Image File Execution Options entry, which is the conventional location and requires elevation (a UAC prompt).
alternatives: HKLM IFEO with elevation, accepting the UAC prompt
enable process-creation auditing and identify how Steam launches the client (also a policy change)
finish statically: find the initialiser that fills the singleton table before any window exists
not_claimed: that IFEO cannot work at all
any change to the shipped client
